trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: It cannot be missed as long as you finish the list; keep the missable trophies in view while chapters are still active. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: An unskippable tutorial-style hunt with no rating requirements; it pops as the closing dialogue ends. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Nothing optional in this chapter feeds the trophy, so enjoy the story without detour pressure. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Check the missable list before leaving this chapter — Sneakthief's jewelry-store window is easy to walk past. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Use any downtime in this chapter to sample one of each activity toward Master of None. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story-only unlock; community trackers note no collectible gating on the chapter roll. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Credits-roll trophy. If you somehow move past it, re-select the finale from the mission replay menu. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A short errand with no medal targets; complete it whenever the story offers it. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A long multi-phase heist late in the campaign; saves before each phase help with the optional challenges. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Completion alone unlocks it — no time or accuracy conditions attached. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finale-style mission; only completion matters, and it can be replayed from the menu. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA sequence; the mission's later checkpoint makes a failed stunt run cheap to retry. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Wrap-up operation that auto-unlocks on completion; no optional objectives required. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Every tracked stat line must be green: missions, strangers, collectible sets, activities and exploration. Use the pause-menu checklist and hunt what is missing last. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt locations cluster; clear them region by region rather than criss-crossing the state. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Tick off one session of each activity category; the tracker only needs a taste of every type. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Widely called the toughest non-platinum trophy; learn the pistol and SMG drill layouts before attempting gold runs. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Learn each race's shortcut corners first; a practice lap per venue saves retries. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty distinct race events, not twenty repeats — rotate circuits to keep the counter moving. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Low-pressure duel with generous retry chances; watch for bite windows rather than spamming. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet counts, so grab this during a story visit to a bar instead of a dedicated trip. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A late-game stranger arc; some guides warn its availability narrows after certain story beats, so start it early. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: The airboat section is the fiddly part; slow around the mangroves to avoid restarts. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: A cross-state ride; keep a fast bike stashed near the start to cut travel time. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight strands for strangers around Leonida; several close off once the story ends, so weave them into your playthrough. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: A hunting-adjacent strand whose final mission closes late; do not leave it for post-game. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Music-industry storyline that concludes with this mission; pure completion, no rating needed. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditation points show under a dedicated map filter; sweep them alongside exploration so the map stays useful. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: The unique animal is a fixed target for Bret's strand; the trophy cares about the kill, not the pelt grade. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Three complete card sets — full sets, not loose cards — so chase one theme at a time. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Progress counts each distinct WAiNK spot once; grind it while free-roaming between story beats. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenge progress overlaps heavily with stunt jumps, so chase both in the same sessions. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs an active co-op partner and a four-star heat; guides warn it can slip away if left past the endgame window. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies without dropping the wanted level; pick tightly spaced shops on one highway. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovery is per distinct vehicle model; valet lots, showrooms and heavy traffic fill the list quickly. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Any dense firefight works — reload-heavy story missions make refilling targets trivial. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: One specific runway departure at the airport; the exact ramp matters, so follow the guide's approach line. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A joke-flavored unlock tied to the Rhino tank; grab it during any story stretch that grants armor access. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A jewelry-store robbery with a no-detection rule; guards reset the attempt if spotted, so memorize patrol timing. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five successful vault jobs and clean getaways; vaults share a cooldown, so rotate between city branches. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the highways during daylight and force the back doors before escaping the heat. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Exploration stat covering every region; swamp and island interiors are the usual last holdouts. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each gang runs one illegal operation; the markers only appear across later chapters, so wait for all of them. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A toast with a view on Ocean Beach during a specific early stretch — the venue closes later in the story, so do it when first available. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a showroom in a specific staged way; approach from the street straight-on as guides describe. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Access to the private venue comes first; get the invitation sorted before attempting the follow-through throw. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Earned through repeated cooperative public actions with your partner; natural play usually gets there. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Trophy pops whichever way the story branch resolves, so no choice can actually lose it. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Deliberately dying once during the right sequence is the accepted shortcut; extremely easy when done on purpose. Sources: GTA Wiki; PlayStationTrophies.org All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Triggered by following a scripted sequence in its written order; the steps matter, so check a guide first. Sources: PSNProfiles; GameFAQs All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by on bowling pins along a slow street with an open window; easier than it sounds. Sources: PowerPyx; Exophase All three big trophy sites flag it missable.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills laundering is cumulative across the whole game, so passively funnel income into it. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org; GTA Forums

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Every shop category counts toward the $100,000, and garage purchases stack toward Little Boxes too. Sources: GameFAQs; GTA Wiki

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Garage properties are pricey; fund them with laundering and heist income before buying them all. Sources: Exophase; PSNProfiles

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register any ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app; a single freeroam session covers it. Sources: GTA Forums; PSNProfiles

roadmap.title: Plan the run around the missables
roadmap.detail: Skim the missable list (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Sneakthief, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin, Catch Me If You Can) and keep this tracker open during the story.

roadmap.title: Story playthrough with side content woven in
roadmap.detail: Play chapters in order. Start every stranger strand when it opens (several close after the finale), sample one of each activity for Master of None, and handle the window-limited missables as they appear.

roadmap.title: Finish the story and remaining strangers
roadmap.detail: Complete the final mission for You Gotta Know When to Get Off, then clear the eight Strangers & Freaks strands plus Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret.

roadmap.title: Freeroam: vehicles, map and WAiNK
roadmap.detail: Discover 100 vehicles (Whip It Good), explore all of Leonida (The Goodtime State), WAiNK 100 spots (You WAiNKer!) and register ten vehicles via Scooter Bros.

roadmap.title: Stunts and challenges
roadmap.detail: Work through 250 stunt jumps (Cunning Stunts) while stacking the 50 Challenges counter (One Last Thing) — they overlap heavily.

roadmap.title: Activities grind
roadmap.detail: Shooting-range golds (The Shootist, the toughest trophy), Top Fun races at every venue, 20 race wins, the fishing duel with Cal and an arcade cabinet.

roadmap.title: Heists, combat and money
roadmap.detail: Five bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal), an armored truck (A Classic Blitz Play), every gang operation (Pest Control), a five-man Combat Focus (Gunslinger), $250k laundered and $100k spent.

roadmap.title: Mop-up to 100%
roadmap.detail: Clear the last lines of the pause-menu checklist for A Long Road (100% Completion). Vice Got a Price! lands with the 54th trophy; expect roughly 90-120 hours total.
